title: ML Attack Surface
description: Interactive Mermaid diagram of the machine-learning training and inference pipelines with four attack vectors pointing in: data poisoning, adversarial evasion, model theft, and prompt injection. Hover any stage or attack for details.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: Machine-learning security and the ML attack surface
learningObjectives: Identify the stages of the ML training and inference pipelines.
Match each ML-specific attack (poisoning, evasion, theft, prompt injection) to the pipeline stage it targets.
Explain why training-time and inference-time attacks require different defenses.
educational.prerequisites: Basic familiarity with how a model is trained and queried.

pedagogical.modelType: interactive workflow diagram with overlaid attack vectors
pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to place a given attack at the correct stage and propose a defense.
misconceptionsAddressed: Assuming all ML attacks happen at inference time.
Believing data cleaning alone defeats data poisoning.
Treating prompt injection as a model bug rather than a trust-boundary failure.
